course_name_original: Stage découverte de l’entreprise / Company discovery internship

learning_outcomes.text: To be able to occupy a position without responsibility other than that related to the work assigned and to know the social relations within the establishment.
The worker internship aims to give the engineering student the most complete possible vision of the functioning of a company (nature and organization of work, hierarchy, human relations…).
To work at a single workstation as an operator, to know the state of the company’s labor relations.
The manufacturing internship aims to give the student a full understanding of a company’s operations (nature and organization of work, chain of command, labor relations…).

syllabus_topics: Importance of human contacts and social relations within the company
Working within a production workshop, a maintenance unit
Working in any industrial sector of activity (heavy industries, transportation, civil engineering, chemical engineering)
Working within a company of more than 50 employees
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
